To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of antioxidants during Agrobacterium transformation and regeneration of transgenic plants can improve transformation efficiency.

the addition of antioxidants such as ascorbic acid (AsA) and glutathione (GSH) to plant transformation medium can improve transformation efficiency and that the addition of antioxidant to plant transformation medium is a useful strategy to improve the efficiency of genetic transformation.

the addition of exogenous antioxidants to the transformation medium significantly improves plant transformation efficiency in many plant species by inhibiting the browning and necroses of transformed cells/tissue and shoot escapes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of ROS and the opportunities to use antioxidants to reduce ROS levels in transformed plant cells and to improve transformation efficiency.

the development of new transformation methods that are based on the application of antioxidants to improve transformation efficiency and to reduce the occurrence of shoot escape in plant transformation.
the role of ROS and antioxidants in tissue browning/necrosis, recalcitrant tissue, and shoot escapes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

antioxidants have a potential role in improving the plant transformation efficiency, and further research is needed to fully understand the mechanism of antioxidants in plant tissue culture and genetic transformation process.
the role of ROS and the use of antioxidants in plant genetic transformation is still in the infancy of its development.
the use of antioxidants in the transformation process may improve transformation efficiency and reduce the number of shoot escapes.

ROS are involved in the browning and necrotic responses during in vitro transformation.

The main takeaway from our work is that
antioxidants can be used to improve transformation efficiency by reducing tissue browning and/or necrosis and by reducing recalcitrance.
ROS play a significant role in tissue browing, recalcitrant, and shoot escapes during transformation and the use of antioxidants can help reduce these problems.
antioxidants can be used to reduce the negative effects of ROS on plant transformation, and thus increase transformation efficiency in many plant species.
